differential.name: Acute non‑ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
differential.rationale: Patient has documented acute NSTEMI and multiple risk factors (HTN, dyslipidemia, diabetes, prior MI) consistent with current presentation.

differential.name: Unstable angina
differential.rationale: Similar risk profile with chest discomfort but without definitive troponin rise; often in the same clinical spectrum as NSTEMI.

differential.name: Acute decompensated heart failure
differential.rationale: Recent MI can precipitate left‑ventricular dysfunction; elevated BMI and hypertension increase risk of volume overload.

differential.name: Acute kidney injury on chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Creatinine ~1.9 mg/dL (critical flag) suggests worsening renal function, possibly from contrast, NSAIDs, or hemodynamic changes during MI.

differential.name: Hypertensive emergency
differential.rationale: History of uncontrolled hypertension; acute rise can accompany MI and contribute to end‑organ damage (brain, kidney, heart).
